// diagnostic E0762

Jet.ContextFieldTypeMismatch

`#Context` field type mismatch (`allocator` takes an allocator handle or `mem.Allocator`, `dir` takes `String` or `files.Path`, `env` takes `[String:String]` or `{KEY: "value"}`)

What

`#Context` field type mismatch (`allocator` takes an allocator handle or `mem.Allocator`, `dir` takes `String` or `files.Path`, `env` takes `[String:String]` or `{KEY: "value"}`)

Why

Each context field (`allocator`, `logger`, `on_stop`, `dir`, `env`) holds one kind of value, so the code under it can rely on that type

Fix

Give each `#Context` field its required type.

Worked example

First UI snapshot mentioning Jet.ContextFieldTypeMismatch: Tests/UI/context_effect_handler_mismatch_e0762.stderr.

Error: Jet.ContextFieldTypeMismatch: `Clock` needs a handler implementing `Clock`, got `NotAClock`
  --> Tests/UI/context_effect_handler_mismatch_e0762.jet:12:14
    |
 12 |     #Context(Clock: NotAClock{value: 1}) {
    |              ^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^
 Why: Installing an `#Effect` provider in `#Context(Clock: ...)` requires a value whose type implements `Clock`
 Fix: Implement `Clock` for ``NotAClock`` or pass a type that implements `Clock`
